name: BentoTile
label: Bento tile
description: A feature tile for a bento grid, with a safe content area, a shader pair, solid or transparent background, and an overlay it opens into.

props.name: title
props.description:
The tile's heading, also the overlay's title.
Note: this shadows the native `title` tooltip attribute, which BentoTile does not expose.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The heading level the title renders at, to fit the page's outline. Never `1`: a tile is never the page's top heading.

props.name: background
props.description:
What sits behind the content: the container surface with a shader pair
over it (a wash of light in the bottom-left corner with a line texture
laid over it, the default), the plain surface, or nothing.

props.name: highlight
props.description:
Which of the six shader pairs the tile wears: pair N is ambient colour N
with texture N. Unset, tiles rotate through the set by their position
among their siblings, so a grid of shader tiles comes out told apart.

props.name: align
props.description: Where the content sits in the space under the heading. Content that does not fit fades out at the edge it overflows.

props.name: children
props.description: The tile's content. Inert while the tile is expandable, since the whole tile is then the control.

props.name: expandedContent
props.description: What the overlay shows under the title. Passing it makes the tile expandable.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the overlay opens or closes.

props.name: expandLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the expand control. Defaults to "Open" and the title, when the title is a string.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the overlay's close control.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes on the tile.
